title: Threshold — Environment Interaction Framework
description:
Threshold turns Foundry's walls into real doors, windows and barriers. System-agnostic: dungeons, starships, haunted manors and cyberpunk towers alike.

  • 15 ready-made barriers: see-through gates, glass and frosted-glass doors, windows, curtains, bars, arrow slits, force fields, barricades and more.
  • Independent channels: movement, sight, light, sound, cover and projectiles, each set per state: closed, open, ajar, locked, damaged.
  • Doors that really open ajar: the leaf swings on its hinge and Foundry's vision shows only what can be seen through the gap. Alt + mouse wheel on the door icon, for GMs and players.
  • Durability: a bar on the map and damage/repair macros; smashed windows and broken barricades stop blocking what they no longer can.
  • 16 textures, a Threshold tab in the wall sheet with a live state matrix, and an illustrated in-game guide (English and Polish).
